question: Should CodexBar add and maintain sub2api as a native built-in provider with group-key account configuration?
rationale: The implementation is credible, but it permanently expands the built-in provider catalog, provider ID and configuration contract, settings UI, documentation, and maintenance surface.

options.title: Accept native provider
options.body: Adopt sub2api as an optional built-in provider and proceed through normal final merge checks.

options.title: Decline built-in support
options.body: Keep the native provider catalog narrower and close the PR without adopting this integration.

recommendation.title: Accept native provider
recommendation.body: Adopt sub2api as an optional built-in provider and proceed through normal final merge checks.

likelyOwner.reason: The current provider framework and shared token-account state trace primarily to steipete, who also merged recent provider additions.
